findings.title: Stop and join the reader before asserting its results
findings.body: Setting deletedAll to true does not wait for the reader's current HTTP request to finish. The assertion can therefore see an empty caughtExceptions list and pass even if that in-flight request subsequently fails with the NPE this test is intended to catch. Also, if any deletion throws, deletedAll is never set and the non-daemon reader continues making requests after the test fails. Retain the reader thread, signal it to stop in a finally block, and wait for it to terminate before checking caughtExceptions.
